Name: Gifts From Leah - Nature Gifts and Inspired Art
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
Receive a gift by mail at every level of friendship with Leah

Finally a good reason to make new friends 

Gifts range from seeds to machines, it will depend on your new friend and how much you are friends 

Each has a unique selection of gifts that will give you!


[spoiler]

[list=1]
[*]Poppy Seeds x10[/*]
[*]Carved Brazier[/*]
[*]Kale x3[/*]
[*]Salad[/*]
[*]Apricot Sapling[/*]
[*]Cherry Sapling[/*]
[*]Orange Sapling[/*]
[*]Peach Sapling[/*]
[*]Pomegranate Sapling[/*]
[*]Apple Sapling[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][b][size=3]-> Installation <-[/size][/b][size=3] [/size]
[/center]
1- Download the desired mod directly from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley]Nexus Mods[/url] [b]This is the only site where I put my Mods [/b]
2- Move the zip file to your Stardew Valley's Mods folder
3- Extract the files in the Mods folder 
4- Run the game with the SMAPI launcher 
5- Enjoy the game with my mod and be happy!
[center][size=3][b]-> Uninstall <-[/b] [/size][/center]

1- Delete the folder containing the Mod files that is located in your Stardew Valley's Mods folder 
2- Go back on the  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley]Nexus Mods[/url] and leave a comment saying why you uninstalled the mod [s](Optional)[/s]
3- Too bad you don't want me anymore, but I'll get over it 
4- Go ahead and have fun in Stardew Valley without me  
[center][size=3][b]-> Update <-[/b] [/size][/center]
1- Delete the folder containing the Mod files that is located in your Stardew Valley's Mods folder 
2- Proceed with the installation of the update normally, follow from step 2 of the installation 
[b]*Update note [/b]
[i]Do not replace or overwrite the files in the folder, this may cause errors
Delete first, and only then extract the new files from the update in the mods folder [/i]  
Feel free to comment and suggest improvements.
